title: A smooth path can hide a sudden identity change.
idea: Project a seeded high-dimensional token vocabulary onto the source/noise plane while calculating rank in the original dimension. Expose pairwise crossings and compare geometric with toy semantic time allocation.
controls: Dimension 8, 32, 128 or 512; vocabulary size; seed; noising progress; linear versus spherical path; step budget with equal/adaptive grids shown together; shrink-without-noise preset; PNG/GIF export.
misconception: Equal geometric steps erase equal semantic information, or nearest-token changes under shrinking norms always imply directional identity loss.
connection: LLaCO · 23 Oct 2026. Cosine similarity, spherical interpolation and rank statistics are older foundations. Implemented synthetic unit-vector lab with a toy rank schedule; not pretrained embeddings, the paper’s fitted 8B calibration or language generation.
audience: ML engineers and technically curious creators
recommendation: Recommended weekly pairing with LLaCO. The original synthetic lab makes token competition and time allocation visible; it is not model inference.

title: Eight calls can contain thirty-two updates
idea: Animate a fine trajectory grid grouped into fused model calls, then separate model evaluation time from encoding and decoding overhead.
controls: Fine-grid resolution; predictions per call; model-call cost; fixed overhead; teacher/student approximation error; planned PNG/GIF export.
misconception: A sampling step always equals one network call, or a 50-to-8 evaluation reduction guarantees the same speedup on every device.
connection: FastH3 Omni announcement · 20 Oct 2026. New coverage of fused PDD predictions and complete-serving comparisons. Analytic schematic, not trained FastH3 or its measured latency.
recommendation: Strong alternative for a mechanism-first follow-up: make compute units visible and keep quality uncertainty explicit.

title: Following a sequence and matching a population are different jobs.
idea: Move colored generated samples toward reference feature clouds while separately preserving paired continuation arrows. Display MMD and continuation errors as gradient weights vary.
controls: Kernel bandwidth; paired-versus-distribution loss weight; sample diversity; history perturbation; toy optimization step; PNG/GIF planned.
misconception: A population that looks right guarantees the correct next event for a particular history, or stronger paired loss alone prevents rollout drift.
connection: Direct Forcing · 22 Oct 2026; maximum mean discrepancy is an older foundation. Analytic feature-space toy, not video training or reported VBench reproduction.
audience: Video-model engineers and advanced ML learners
recommendation: Strong follow-up to explain why training objectives complement each other.

title: The shadow belongs to the edit too.
idea: A small composited scene links object, shadow, reflection and background layers. An object-only mask leaves a ghost; an interaction mask updates connected effects.
controls: Object position; light direction; shadow/reflection toggles; mask dilation; effect-aware removal; PNG/GIF planned.
misconception: Removing an object is equivalent to removing only its visible pixels, or inpainted background reveals the hidden truth.
connection: UniVOE · 22 Oct paper, 21 Oct weight files. Compositing and dependency-aware editing are the foundations; demonstration is synthetic and does not run UniVOE.
recommendation: Most immediately legible filmmaking lesson; include effects beyond a simple shadow.

title: Freeze time. Move the camera.
idea: A colored Gaussian scene with fixed background splats and moving foreground splats; separate panels reveal static aggregation and dynamic interpolation.
controls: Independent time and camera-orbit sliders; Static/dynamic probability threshold; Velocity-arrow display; Interpolation amount and occlusion overlay; planned PNG/GIF export in light, minimal theme.
misconception: A plausible generated video already contains an explicit, reusable 4D scene.
connection: SplatFlux · 20 Oct 2026. A shared decoder converts observed or generated video latents into 4D Gaussians, separating static structure from moving primitives. Motion interpolation supports changing time and viewpoint without rerunning a network at each timestamp. Synthetic analytic Gaussian demonstration, not SplatFlux inference or recovered geometry.
recommendation: Retained October 23 proposal, not implemented or a new October 26 paper. Useful next 3D lesson after the existing streaming lab.

title: Sharp edges do not make an editable scene
idea: Zoom an original colored graphic and switch between raster pixels, polygons and Bezier curves. Inspect path grouping separately from object identity and live text.
controls: Zoom, curve tolerance, node budget, shape-selection versus object-selection, text-as-outline toggle; planned PNG/GIF export.
misconception: An SVG is automatically semantically organized, easily editable typography or a compact file.
connection: Ideogram Vector host integration · 23 Oct 2026. Older vector/raster representation foundations applied to a new feature; analytic original artwork, not generated model output.
recommendation: Useful image-generation counterpart to the deeper 3D lab.

title: The voice reads a different script
idea: Show how typed dates, prices and abbreviations become spoken text before acoustic generation; expose where a voice-quality comparison can hide preprocessing differences.
controls: Language; number/date format; abbreviation; normalized-text diff; audio-frame duration; playback buffer; planned PNG/GIF export.
misconception: A better voice model automatically fixes the wrong spoken interpretation, or a new runtime release means new model weights.
connection: Phonon normalization API · v0.4.1 published 24 Oct; v0.4.2 on 25 Oct. This extends last week's streaming-audio angle with a new preflight feature. Illustrative transformations must be labeled unless tested against the API.
recommendation: Useful small explainer and practical narration checklist; lower priority than the deep weekly interactive.

title: Change one line. Which assets must change?
idea: Build a colored dependency graph for script, actors, shots, voice lines and final edit; highlight downstream invalidation after an edit.
controls: Dependency links, changed input, caching policy, retry count, per-node assumed cost; planned PNG/GIF export.
misconception: A five-minute assembled film is one five-minute native generation, or every edit requires regenerating everything.
connection: Higgsfield Content Factory · 22 Oct; Runway App Studio · 23 Oct 2026. Analytic dependency/caching lesson, not a connection to either paid product.
recommendation: Proposed follow-up; prioritize after the current weekly publishing kit.
